newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Xinjiang reports record cotton harvest.
newsitem.headline: China's Xinjiang reports record cotton harvest.

text.p: China's northwestern Xinjiang region has reported a record cotton harvest of 1.05 million tonnes this year, despite cold, hail and floods, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.

Cotton farmers in the remote region had harvested 100,000 tonnes more cotton than last year, although low temperatures and bad weather had caused output to fall on 17,467 hectares of cotton fields, the official agency said.
Xinjiang, China's key cotton-producing region, planted 785,000 hectares of cotton this year, 55,000 hectares more than in 1995, Xinhua said last week.
Average yield per hectare rose by 60 kg, because of the extensive use of wide plastic sheeting, organic fertilisers and better cotton strains, it said.
Official media has said China's total cotton crop could fall to 3.8 million tonnes in 1996 from 4.5 million tonnes last year.
